### Revision
Revision represents a Git revision that can be resolved to an object ID.


| Field | Type | Label | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| name | [bytes](https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/proto3#scalar) |  | <p>name is the name of the revision. (required)</p> |
